CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

3. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

5. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 8

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 14

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 55
   D. 22

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 30

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 30

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 77

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 43

23. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 10

24. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
